model.name: english_tinystories_c512_l6
model.description: Open English on TinyStories only. C=512 L=6 H=8 head=64 T=256, GPT-2 residual scale 1/sqrt(2L). Same TinyStories BPE as c256. New weights. Do not --resume english_tinystories_c256_l6. 2 GB cap hardcoded.

metadata.description: Wider residual stream on the existing TinyStories token shards. Same BPE, same windows. 8192 tokens per optimizer step (batch 8 x accum 4, effective batch 32). Fresh init. One epoch is ≈188444 optimizer steps. Do not resume the c256 checkpoint.
